    CandidateSelector
    Narrows the event pool to at most MAX_CANDIDATES before AI ranking, to keep token usage bounded.

    Uses the AI client to reformat raw Ticketmaster HTML descriptions into clean prose; results are cached per event id for the run lifetime, and any failure falls back to the original text.

    Ranks candidate events against a user's interest profile using the AI client.

    Assembles a InterestProfile from everything the app already knows about a user.
    RecommendationCache
    Keeps the last ranking in memory for the logged-in user, so reopening the browse screen or changing a filter does not spend another AI call.
